serverInfo.name: agentdeals
serverInfo.description: AgentDeals helps developers find free tiers, startup credits, and deals on developer infrastructure. Use these tools when a user is evaluating cloud providers, databases, hosting, CI/CD, monitoring, auth, AI services, or any developer service — especially when cost matters. 1,400+ offers across 60 categories, re-read on a schedule, with pricing change tracking. Of the 1,493 entries we hold, 463 carry terms a read confirmed in the last 90 days.
